title: A technician with no photo shows initials in headers and avatar groups
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has it).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. At least 2 technicians are eligible at this location and have no profile photo (e.g. "Theresa Webb" and "Jenny Wilson"; a newly added staff member has no photo). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Theresa Webb") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  6. Create the work order: Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the case customer (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") and its asset > create it, and write down its number (e.g. "S1-702").
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician to "Theresa Webb".
    • On the Lines tab click New Line, enter a name (e.g. "Brake inspection") and labor hours (e.g. 2.0), and save the line.
    • Give the line to "Jenny Wilson" (Edit Line > Technicians, pick Jenny Wilson, save) so the work order has a line technician besides the lead.
    • Click the line's Approve (check) button so the work order status reads Approved.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab.
  3. Type the case customer's name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") in Search.
  4. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (in the design its tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  5. Read the avatar beside Theresa Webb's name in her group header.
  6. Click the Columns button in the toolbar (in the design its tooltip reads "Columns").
  7. Tick Assigned Techs (in the design the column reads "Assigned Tech").
  8. Read the avatar group in the work order's row.
  9. In the display switcher click Board View (in the design its tooltip reads "Board").
  10. Read the avatar beside Theresa Webb's name in her column header.
  11. Click Fields to display in the toolbar.
  12. Turn line technicians on.
  13. Read the avatar group on the work order's card.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 5 and 10: Theresa Webb's header shows a round avatar holding her initials "TW" (first letter of the first name, then first letter of the last name), next to her name and the count.
  • Steps 8 and 13: the avatar group shows "TW" first and "JW" for Jenny Wilson, each in its own round avatar.
  • Nowhere is an empty circle, a blank space or a broken-image icon shown in place of an avatar.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View) and SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View) and SV-10050 (Story 7, line technicians); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S2-R12, S3-R12, S7-R1, read 8 Oct 2026. The PRD requires an avatar but does not say what it shows without a photo; the design does: design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Work Orders.dc.html) renders header avatars through SVAvatarFix and avatar groups through SVTechStack from the design system bundle (_ds_bundle.js L9963-L10013 StaffAvatar: photo, otherwise initials, also when the photo fails to load; L10015-L10096 TechStack). Design crawl 8 Oct shows initials avatars such as "TW", "JW", "KW" beside photo avatars. Design-only detail, cited to the design. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified. Design: the Work Orders design export uploaded by the QA lead on 8 Oct 2026 (on-screen labels and the design-only detail in this case).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R12: “Each group header shows the technician’s name, avatar, and a count of the work orders currently shown in that group, after the filter view and filters are applied, so the count always matches the rows listed.”
  • S3-R12: “Each column header shows the technician’s name, avatar, and a count of the work orders currently shown in that column, after the filter view and filters are applied, so the count always matches the cards listed.”
  • S7-R1: “Board View cards (when the line technicians field is on) and a new optional Assigned Techs column in Tech View show a compact avatar group: the lead technician plus the distinct technicians assigned to work order lines. List does not get this column.”
